keyFindings.description: The frozen-wording argument names ASK_NOT_OPEN but not decidedWordingRestore (docs/decided_wording.go), the one other writer of a decided row's question, options, multiple and urgency. Both orderings walked: the repair moves the approved block from passing to failing (a refusal), never the reverse, so the rule stays safe; the comment should name the exception. Fast-follow.

blockAsItsRowHasIt and blockAsSettlementLeavesIt are near-synonyms and the weaker one's name matches heldAsItsRow's; a future edit aligning heldAsItsRow with blockAsItsRowHasIt would reinstate this issue on the decided-wording branch (the one an agent reaches over HTTP). Rename the weaker predicate to its server-attribute half. Fast-follow.

A refused carry records nothing (no log, event or field), as on the base; this change adds a timing-dependent refusal (an approval inside the settle window over an agent's in-flight reword) with no record of which block refused. Not a regression; observability debt noted on the PR body's Not proven / risk line.
